recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, low-angle group portrait set against a backdrop of urban tenement buildings and a clear sky. Three figures in leather jackets and denim are positioned at varying heights, creating a sense of verticality and movement, with one figure appearing to jump or crouch above the viewer.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme low-angle perspective looking up at subjects and buildings
Triangular composition formed by the three figures
Contrast between dark leather textures and bright blue sky
Converging vertical lines of the architecture creating depth
coreInvariants: Leather jackets as a primary wardrobe element
Urban fire escape and brick building textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects distributed across the frame; one large figure in the upper right foreground, one mid-ground figure on the left, and one central figure at the bottom looking upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure at the bottom, whose gaze leads the eye upward toward the sky and the other subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A circular path starting from the bottom center, moving up the left side, across the top figure, and down the right architectural edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky between the buildings and figures provides a bright, open negative space that balances the dense urban textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues from the sky and denim jeans.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black from the leather jackets and shadowed building recesses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and light grey from the building facades and sneakers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark foreground figures and the bright, saturated blue sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and tracking of the same sans-serif family to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Angled text baseline to match the dynamic perspective

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, bold feel of the primary text.
Provides a similar urban, editorial aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of three people in 1980s urban streetwear (leather jackets, denim) posing dynamically against a backdrop of New York-style brick tenement buildings and a bright blue sky. The camera should be looking straight up from the ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, bold, condensed sans-serif text in the top left corner, rotated 15 degrees upward to follow the perspective of the buildings.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle extremely low?
Are the figures wearing leather jackets?
Is the sky a prominent background element?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original title

avoid: Cluttered foregrounds that obscure the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure building perspective lines converge correctly
Verify text legibility against the sky
Confirm the low-angle 'hero' feel of the subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Low-Angle + Leather/Denim Wardrobe + Condensed Bold Sans-Serif + Diagonal Layout
